headline: Casablanca premieres in New York
post_facts: Rushed out during the North Africa campaign

scenes.text: [calmly] On this day, in nineteen forty-two... Casablanca premiered in New York City.

scenes.label: Bogart and Bergman
scenes.caption: Casablanca, Warner Bros., 1942
scenes.text: [thoughtfully] Warner Brothers rushed it out, just weeks after Allied troops landed in North Africa.

scenes.label: Oscars, including Best Picture
scenes.text: [calmly] It went on to win three Oscars, including Best Picture.

scenes.label: The cast
scenes.caption: From the 1942 trailer
scenes.text: [softly] Humphrey Bogart and Ingrid Bergman played old lovers... torn apart by the war.
